subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — SDK/auth/streaming & tool-calling tasks
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Foster <alex@brightlinehealth.com>; Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — SDK/auth/streaming & tool-calling tasks

Hi Alex / team,

Quick weekly checkpoint on the mutual action plan and the evaluation timeline — focused today on SDK integration, auth handoff, streaming contract, and tool-calling readiness. Attached is the updated MAP workbook (tabbed by stream). Please see short status bullets and open actions below.

Status highlights:
- SDK: basic client + examples done; working through edge-case retries and token refresh in the JS SDK.
- Auth: OIDC flow defined; need customer test client for redirect URIs and consent scopes.
- Streaming: server-side chunking stable; initial perf numbers in spreadsheet.
- Tool calling: proto design agreed; we need the Brightline tool spec (call patterns) to finalize adaptor.

Open actions (owners / target):
1) Brightline to share redirect URIs + test client values — owner: Alex — due: 2027-05-18
2) Redwood to ship JS SDK v0.9.1 with token-refresh sample — owner: Monica — due: 2027-05-17
3) Redwood infra to publish streaming SLOs and bandwidth guide — owner: Karthik — due: 2027-05-19
4) Brightline to provide tool-calling spec (sample payloads) — owner: Alex — due: 2027-05-20
5) Camila to run integration smoke tests once 1–4 are available — owner: Camila — due: 2027-05-21

Meeting: on Tuesday we have the technical sync (10:00 PT). Please flag any blockers before then.

Attachments: MAP_Master_20270515.xlsx (MAP workbook), auth_flow_diagram.png

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai

--
From: Alex Foster <alex@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — SDK/auth/streaming & tool-calling tasks

Neha — thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We will export the redirect URIs and a test client today; I should have that to you by EOD Monday (2027-05-17).
- For the tool-calling spec, I can share an initial dump of the payloads and expected responses — I'll send that by 2027-05-19.
- One potential risk: our security team wants an explicit list of scopes the SDK will request; can Monica include a short scope breakdown in the SDK release notes?

I'll bring this up in our internal procurement sync and loop back if anything slips.

Best,
Alex Foster
Head of Integrations — Brightline Health
alex@brightlinehealth.com

--
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Foster <alex@brightlinehealth.com>; Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — SDK/auth/streaming & tool-calling tasks

Alex — noted on the scope ask. I'll add a 'requested scopes' section to the SDK release notes and include a short example of minimal scopes vs expanded scopes.

Quick dev update (today):
- Pushed token-refresh reference to the sdk-examples repo (branch: refresh-sample).
- Added retry/backoff recommendations for 429 and 503; currently gated by nightly tests.
- Packaging JS SDK v0.9.1; link and CHANGELOG will be in HubSpot once published.

Action updates:
- Monica -> SDK v0.9.1 publish + scope notes — target 2027-05-17 (in progress)
- Karthik -> streaming SLO doc (draft) — target 2027-05-19 (ETA this week)

Camila: once Alex shares tool payloads can you confirm the required fields we need to accept for tool-calls? If you prefer, I can wire a simple mock endpoint you can use for smoke tests.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior SWE, Integrations — Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

--
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Foster <alex@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — SDK/auth/streaming & tool-calling tasks

Folks — a couple infrastructure notes:

- Streaming SLO draft is up in the shared Drive (link in MAP workbook). It includes expected throughput per connection, reconnect recommendations, and token lifecycle guidance. Feedback welcome; I'll incorporate before Tuesday.
- Bandwidth: we recommend 1.5x headroom for peak periods (details in the SLO doc).
- We're also preparing a test harness for simulated high-churn streaming to validate KV cache behavior; Camila, I'll share access to that by Monday.

Open dependency: if Brightline plans to use tool-calling in high-frequency loops (>10 calls/second per user session), we should size an outbound adaptor—Alex, please indicate expected QPS in your payload doc.

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

--
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Foster <alex@brightlinehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — SDK/auth/streaming & tool-calling tasks

Thanks everyone — quick operational checklist from my side: 

- I'll run the first pass smoke tests on Tuesday morning after Monica publishes v0.9.1. If Alex's test client arrives earlier I can run an initial auth flow smoke today in my sandbox.
- Rishi will own the results matrix and logging correlation for tool-calling traces. Rishi, ping me once you have the correlation keys from the infra harness.
- I'll log any failing test cases directly into the MAP workbook (tab: integration-issues).

No blockers from devops today.

Camila Reyes
Integration Lead — Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
